TOGGLE.label: Show me my reading summary
TOGGLE.promise: We count the coverage tiers you read. We do not store which stories you opened.
TOGGLE.shortNotice: If you turn this on, we keep a running count of how many stories you open from government-aligned, mainstream and watchdog outlets — three numbers, nothing more. We never build a list of the stories you read. It is used only to show you your own summary.
TOGGLE.notUsedFor: Not used to profile your politics. Not used for advertising. Not sold or shared. Not used to train anything.
TOGGLE.refusalIsFree: You can leave this off. Everything else on TraceNews works exactly the same.
TOGGLE.withdrawal: You can turn it off at any time. Turning it off stops the counting and deletes your counts. We keep a small record that you turned this on and off, as proof we asked you properly.

FULL_NOTICE.heading: Your reading summary — what we keep
whatWeKeep: Three running counts tied to your account: how many stories you have opened from government-aligned outlets, from mainstream outlets, and from watchdog outlets.
Nothing else. No list of stories. No titles. No subjects. No timestamps of individual reads. No IP address or device fingerprint for this feature.
FULL_NOTICE.technicalLogs: Like every website, our servers keep short technical logs to keep the site running and secure. They are deleted after ___ days, they are never used to build your summary, and we never join them to your account.
whatWeDoNotKeep: We do not store which stories you opened. When you open a story, the relevant counter goes up by one and the event is discarded.
Because that list is never written down, it cannot be leaked, and there is nothing for anyone to demand from us — including a court or an authority.
Your reading counts are never linked to politicians, story subjects, or any of our editorial data.
FULL_NOTICE.purpose: One purpose only: to show you a summary of your own reading. We do not use it for anything else.
FULL_NOTICE.basis: We rely on your consent. You gave it by turning this on, and you can withdraw it at any time by turning it off.
FULL_NOTICE.retention: Your counts are kept while the feature is on. Turn it off, or delete your account, and they are permanently deleted — including from backups within our documented backup cycle. There is no separate reading history to delete, because we never created one.
FULL_NOTICE.consentRecordRetention: One thing we do keep: a short record that you turned this on or off — the date, and which version of this notice you were shown. We keep it because the law requires us to be able to show that we asked for your permission properly. It contains no reading data. If you delete your account, it is kept only for as long as we must, and nothing else.
FULL_NOTICE.seeTheStories: Where a summary offers to show you stories, it opens a public list that every visitor can see — not a record of what you personally read.
rights: See the counts we hold (they are on this screen).
Export them in a machine-readable file.
Object to, or restrict, this processing.
Withdraw consent at any time, as easily as you gave it.
FULL_NOTICE.recipients: No one. These counts are not shared with any third party, and no external analytics service receives them.
FULL_NOTICE.transfers: Your counts are stored on servers in Ireland, operated on our behalf by our hosting providers. Ireland has data-protection laws recognised as providing protection comparable to Nigeria's, and our contracts require those providers to protect your data and to use it only for us.
FULL_NOTICE.automatedDecisions: The summary is a description of your own counts. It makes no decision about you, and has no legal or similar effect on you.
FULL_NOTICE.complaints: You can complain to us at privacy@tracenews.ng or to the Nigeria Data Protection Commission (NDPC).
FULL_NOTICE.contact: Controller: TraceNews Limited (TraceNews). Privacy: privacy@tracenews.ng. Data Protection Officer: dpo@tracenews.ng.
